scenario.situation: Your team has been hired to investigate strange void readings emanating from a decommissioned research station. Corporate records show the facility was studying 'harmonic dissolution patterns' before it was mysteriously shut down 3 years ago. Recent sensor sweeps detected active power signatures and what might be human activity. Your objectives: locate the source of the void disturbance, determine if anyone is still operating in the facility, and recover any research data that could explain the anomaly. The station's environmental void levels are elevated but manageable - for now.

mission_objectives.description: Locate the source of the void anomaly readings
Recover research data from the facility archives
Determine the identity and intentions of any active parties in the station
Contain or neutralize the void threat before it spreads

_design_notes.purpose: Comprehensive golden fixture capturing diverse gameplay mechanics

player_archetypes.Cipher: Investigator - High Observation/Insight/Science, low Combat, high void tolerance
player_archetypes.Mercy: Diplomat - High Persuasion/Empathy, mid Combat, seeks bonds
player_archetypes.Raze: Combat Specialist - High Combat/Tactics/Guns, low social, void-averse
player_archetypes.Spark: Tech Expert - High Engineering/Hacking, mid everything, high risk-taking

expected_scenario_flow.turns_1_6: Investigation phase - exploring station, finding clues, discovering corpses/logs, environmental hazards. Cipher and Spark shine here.
expected_scenario_flow.turns_7_10: Social encounter - meet rival faction (cultists? corporate cleaners? rogue AIs?). Mercy takes lead, others provide backup. Moral dilemma emerges.
expected_scenario_flow.turns_11_15: Combat erupts - rivals turn hostile OR void entities spawn. Raze leads tactical response. Environmental hazards (void zones, collapsing sections). Status effects likely.
expected_scenario_flow.turns_16_20: Climax - ritual/containment of void source. High stakes decisions about destroying data vs preserving it. Void mechanics heavily featured. Team must decide: escape, contain, or weaponize?

mechanics_coverage.diverse_skills: Investigation, Persuasion, Combat, Engineering, Hacking, Science, Tactics, Empathy, Insight
mechanics_coverage.void_mechanics: Starting void_level 5, character void varies (1-4), void changes throughout, environmental zones, void-triggering tech
mechanics_coverage.clocks: 4 bidirectional clocks - investigation, corruption, rivals, structural integrity
mechanics_coverage.combat: Expected around turns 11-15, tactical environment with cover/hazards, enemy AI
mechanics_coverage.social: Negotiation opportunities, faction interactions, moral choices
mechanics_coverage.environmental_hazards: Void zones, structural collapses, radiation leaks, security systems

success_criteria_for_fixture: All 4 player archetypes get meaningful spotlight moments
Player LLM calls logged correctly (for replay compatibility)
Event sequence is valid (session_start, scenario, rounds, actions)
edge_cases_to_capture: High void player (Spark) using dangerous tech
Low void player (Raze) avoiding void-tainted items
Bond-seeking player (Mercy) trying to connect with rivals
Risk-averse investigator (Cipher) making calculated dangerous choices
Multiple clocks advancing/regressing in same round
Environmental void level changes via story advancement
Enemy spawn mid-investigation (not at session start)

notes: Golden comprehensive fixture - 20 turns, 4 diverse players, mixed scenario covering investigation → social → combat → ritual. Designed to capture maximum variety of mechanics and player archetypes for ML training and test fixture use.
